info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Compliance Status API
info.description: The Regulatory Compliance Status API enables businesses to monitor and retrieve the current compliance status regarding various regulatory requirements. This API provides essential insights into compliance status, allowing organizations to maintain adherence to legal and industry standards. Typically used by compliance officers, risk management teams, and regulatory reporting personnel, this endpoint facilitates proactive compliance management. Users can easily access and assess compliance information to ensure ongoing regulatory adherence and mitigate potential risks.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of regulatory compliance.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of regulatory compliance, providing insights into compliance metrics and any outstanding issues that require attention.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters necessary to retrieve the status of regulatory compliance. Ensure that you provide the required fields as specified in the schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, providing the current regulatory compliance status.

GetRegulatoryComplianceStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the regulatory compliance status. This may include various compliance indicators relevant to operations.

GetRegulatoryComplianceStatusResponse_20.title: Regulatory Compliance Status
